name: open-vision-vite
description: An on-site network management tool for Windows tablets. Each tablet is deployed standalone at a single site and provides live network topology visualization and device monitoring.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "uv run --directory backend uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8756" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
